__comment: StratusScan Configuration Template - Copy this file to config.json and customize

account_mappings.__comment: Add your own account mappings in the format 'account_id': 'friendly_name'

cross_account_roles.__comment: Map of account_id to IAM role ARN for cross-account scanning

output_settings.__comment: format: xlsx (requires openpyxl) or csv. destination: 'local' (saves to output/) or 's3' (uploads to the bucket below, then deletes the local copy on success). skip_empty_exports: when true, an exporter that finds no resources writes no spreadsheet (the run report still records it as 'ran, 0 assets'). Set via 'python configure.py' -> Output Settings.
